correctness.rationale: The source return map was reconstructed with all sign and positive-time conditions. At the boundary equality, \(R(A)=0\) and the two flight times are positive exactly under the stated signs. Signed distance gives the exact recurrence \(u_{n+1}=\sqrt{u_n(u_n+2\rho)}\).
